title: Zariski prelog logification, etale extension, and pushout stalks
statement:
Let $X$ be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], with Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site] and small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Write $\epsilon:X_{\mathrm{Et}}\to X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ for the geometric morphism [def-trf-geometric-morphism] whose direct image restricts a sheaf to open subschemes. Let $\mathcal P$ be a sheaf of commutative monoids on $X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ (a presheaf with monoid-homomorphism restrictions whose underlying sets satisfy open-cover gluing), and let $\beta:\mathcal P\to(\mathcal O_X,\cdot)$ be a sheaf homomorphism. For $\tau=\mathrm{Zar},\mathrm{Et}$ put $\mathcal P_{\mathrm{Zar}}=\mathcal P$, $\mathcal P_{\mathrm{Et}}=\epsilon^{-1}\mathcal P$, let $\beta_{\mathrm{Et}}$ be induced by $\beta$ and the structure-sheaf map, and set $\mathcal E_\tau=\beta_\tau^{-1}(\mathcal O_\tau^\times)$. Define
$$L_\tau=\bigl(\mathcal P_\tau\oplus_{\mathcal E_\tau}\mathcal O_\tau^\times\bigr)^\#,$$
where the pushout is formed sectionwise with relations $(pe,u)\sim(p,\beta_\tau(e)u)$ and $(-)^\#$ is commutative-monoid sheafification [lem-trf-commutative-monoid-sheafification]. With structure map $[p,u]\mapsto\beta_\tau(p)u$, $L_\tau$ is a log structure: the inverse image of $\mathcal O_\tau^\times$ is mapped isomorphically onto $\mathcal O_\tau^\times$ [def-trf-fs-log-blowup, with the same definition on the Zariski site]. It is universal for compatible maps from $\mathcal P_\tau$ to log structures.

Let $(\epsilon^{-1}L_{\mathrm{Zar}})^a$ mean the log structure associated to the prelog map $\epsilon^{-1}L_{\mathrm{Zar}}\to\mathcal O_{\mathrm{Et}}$, by this same sheafified-pushout construction. The canonical comparison
$$(\epsilon^{-1}L_{\mathrm{Zar}})^a\xrightarrow{\sim}L_{\mathrm{Et}}$$
is an isomorphism compatible with $\mathcal P$ and the sheaves of units. At $x\in X$, and at every geometric point $\bar x$ over $x$ [def-weil-geometric-point, def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], the canonical maps identify
$$(\epsilon^{-1}\mathcal P)_{\bar x}=\mathcal P_x,\qquad
(L_{\mathrm{Zar}})_x=\mathcal P_x\oplus_{E_x}\mathcal O_{X,x}^\times,\qquad
(L_{\mathrm{Et}})_{\bar x}=\mathcal P_x\oplus_{E_x}\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}^\times,$$
where $E_x=\beta_x^{-1}(\mathcal O_{X,x}^\times)$; the canonical local map $\mathcal O_{X,x}\to\mathcal O_{X,\bar x}$ reflects units, so the same $E_x$ is used in both pushouts. For $\overline L_\tau=(L_\tau/\mathcal O_\tau^\times)^\#$, its stalk is the corresponding displayed pushout modulo the displayed units. All these maps and identifications commute with restriction to open subschemes.
